title: The workspace obligation row was marked covered, but the cited contract defines one branch per task while a card is one run of many tasks, so no per-change branch is proven
resolution: The row is partly covered: the base branch per prepare is cited for the met part, and item 16 closes the per-change branch through a versioned change of the item 6 contract

title: The obligation trace requirement allowed only covered and open, while the table also used partly covered and later-gate statuses
resolution: The requirement names four statuses, covered, partly covered, open, and not a G3 item, each with what it carries, and a scenario covers the partly met case; the table and its legend use the same names
